processing_application.instructions: Preserve the exact original grill-me wrapper and pinned grilling sibling. The wrapper declares user-only invocation and literally requests the native Skill tool; the source-backed application translates sibling dispatch and claims no native or implicit Skill invocation. Use the existing single shared CL session for the selected stable T-task and the frozen W1 decision mode, authority and epoch. Map dependent decisions, ask the complete independent frontier with recommendations, keep downstream questions behind unsettled prerequisites and require current answers and separate final specification acceptance. Manual records actual owner answers and confirmation. Auto records actual bounded DG resolver decisions, an independent critic for significant decisions and an arbiter for substantive disagreement; delegated origin remains delegated origin. A fact-dependent branch requires actual fresh factual-helper evidence. Explicit controller-owned fresh-helper delegation is a translation when nested spawning is unavailable; missing helper capacity retains the dependent prerequisite while independent frontier work can continue. Recommendations, silence, empty frontiers and generic acknowledgements supply no answers or final acceptance. Internal rounds preserve the same session; deliberately repeated configured interview occurrences remain separate calls. The core applies accepted revisions, affected editorial rechecks and final guarded release. Unavailable, stale, cancelled or uncertain obligations retain the hold until supported continuation or explicit accepted configuration reconciliation. Source preparation supplies no candidate execution, native invocation or efficacy evidence. Immutable application scope remains separate from replaceable parameters and extra instructions.
